title: Ensure systemd Service Files Are Enabled
rationale: The PostgreSQL service should be managed by systemd to ensure consistent startup, shutdown, and service management.
remediation: Enable the PostgreSQL service using 'systemctl enable postgresql' or the appropriate service name for your distribution.

title: Ensure Data Cluster Initialized Successfully
rationale: A valid PostgreSQL data cluster is required before the database server can operate correctly.
remediation: Initialize the PostgreSQL cluster using initdb or the distribution-specific initialization utility before starting PostgreSQL.

title: Ensure the file permissions mask is correct
rationale: Restricting permissions on the PostgreSQL data directory prevents unauthorized users from accessing database files.
remediation: Set the PostgreSQL data directory permissions to 700 and ensure it is owned by the PostgreSQL operating system user.
